Package index

Alpha Diversity

Calculate within-sample diversity using various indices.

alpha_div()
Alpha Diversity Wrapper Function

Richness metrics

Estimators focused on the number of species (richness).

ace()
Abundance-based Coverage Estimator (ACE)
chao1()
Chao1 Richness Estimator
margalef()
Margalef's Richness Index
menhinick()
Menhinick's Richness Index
observed()
Observed Features
squares()
Squares Richness Estimator

Diversity metrics

Indices accounting for both richness and evenness.

brillouin()
Brillouin Index
fisher()
Fisher's Alpha
inv_simpson()
Inverse Simpson Index
shannon()
Shannon Diversity Index
simpson()
Gini-Simpson Index

Dominance metrics

Indices focused on the abundance of the most dominant species.

berger()
Berger-Parker Index
mcintosh()
McIntosh Index

Phylogenetic metrics

Diversity based on phylogenetic branch lengths.

faith()
Faith's Phylogenetic Diversity (PD)

Beta Diversity

Calculate between-sample similarity or distance.

beta_div()
Beta Diversity Wrapper Function

Phylogenetic metrics

Distance measures based on phylogenetic branch lengths (the UniFrac family, and the compositional PhILR distance).

Unweighted UniFrac
weighted_unifrac()
Weighted UniFrac
normalized_unifrac()
Normalized Weighted UniFrac
generalized_unifrac()
Generalized UniFrac (GUniFrac)
variance_adjusted_unifrac()

philr_distance()
PhILR Distance

Compositional Data

Log ratios for relative abundances. The centered log ratios (clr and rclr) are norm choices; see normalize().

Zeros

Replace zeros before taking log ratios, instead of adding a pseudocount. replace_zeros() runs any method by name.

replace_zeros()
Zero Replacement
replace_zeros_mult()
Multiplicative Zero Replacement
list_zero_replacements() match_zero_replacement()
Find and Browse Zero Replacement Methods

Log-ratio transforms

Coordinates for analyses of the transformed features themselves. For distances, use aitchison().

alr()
Additive Log-Ratio Transform
ilr()
Isometric Log-Ratio Transform
philr()
Phylogenetic Isometric Log-Ratio Transform (PhILR)

Log ratios

One log ratio per sample, between two groups of features, to use as a variable in tests and models.

log_ratio()
Log Ratio of Summed Abundances
balance()
Isometric Log-Ratio Balance

Proportionality

Which features keep a constant ratio across samples, the compositionally valid alternative to correlation. A dist over the features.

vlr()
Variance of Log Ratios
rho_p()
Proportionality Correlation
phi_s()
Symmetric Proportionality

Differential abundance

Which features’ abundances differ between groups, from log ratios or clr values, so that the samples’ totals don’t matter.

ancom()
Analysis of Composition of Microbiomes (ANCOM)
ancombc() ancombc2()
Analysis of Compositions of Microbiomes with Bias Correction (ANCOM-BC)
ancombc_global() ancombc_pairwise() ancombc_dunnett() ancombc_trend()
Post-hoc tests for ANCOM-BC and ANCOM-BC2
structural_zeros()
Structural zeros
dirmult_ttest()
Dirichlet-multinomial Welch t-tests (ALDEx2-style)

Absolute abundance

With each sample’s total microbial load measured (cell counts, qPCR, a spike-in), estimate absolute abundances instead of ratios.

qmp_scale() qmp_rarefy()
Quantitative Microbiome Profiling: Absolute Abundances from a Measured Load

Ordination

Place samples on a few axes for plotting. dist_ord() runs the methods that take beta diversity distances, and count_ord() the methods that take the count table.

dist_ord()
Distance-based Ordination
count_ord()
Count Table Ordination
pcoa()
Principal Coordinates Analysis (PCoA)
pcoa_biplot()
PCoA Biplot Scores
mds()
Metric Multidimensional Scaling (MDS)
nmds()
Non-metric Multidimensional Scaling (NMDS)
isomap()
Isometric Feature Mapping (Isomap)
tsne()
t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE)
umap()
Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP)
dbrda()
Distance-based Redundancy Analysis (db-RDA)
capscale()
Constrained Analysis of Principal Coordinates (capscale)
rda()
Redundancy Analysis (RDA)
cca()
Canonical Correspondence Analysis (CCA)
ca()
Correspondence Analysis (CA)
pca()
Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
rpca()
Robust Aitchison PCA (RPCA)
rpca_phylo()
Phylogenetic Robust Aitchison PCA
dpcoa()
Double Principal Coordinate Analysis
envfit()
Fit Variables or Taxa onto an Ordination
bioenv()
Best Subset of Environmental Variables (BIOENV)
varpart()
Variation Partitioning
forward_select()
Forward Selection of Explanatory Variables
procrustes()
Procrustes Rotation of One Ordination onto Another
procrustes_test()
Procrustes Randomization Test (PROTEST)
list_dist_ords() match_dist_ord()
Find and Browse Distance-based Ordination Methods
list_count_ords() match_count_ord()
Find and Browse Count Table Ordination Methods

Supervised

Ordinations that look for the axes that separate known groups. They always find some, so validate them with a permutation test such as permanova().

lda()
Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA)
capda()
Discriminant Canonical Analysis of Principal Coordinates (CAP)
plsda()
Partial Least Squares Discriminant Analysis (PLS-DA)
oplsda()
Orthogonal Partial Least Squares Discriminant Analysis (OPLS-DA)

Hypothesis Tests

Test whether sample metadata explain beta diversity distances.

dist_test()
Distance Test Wrapper Function
permanova()
Permutational Multivariate Analysis of Variance (PERMANOVA)
mantel()
Mantel Test
mantel_partial()
Partial Mantel Test
mrpp()
Multi-Response Permutation Procedure (MRPP)
anosim()
Analysis of Similarities (ANOSIM)
permdisp()
Homogeneity of Multivariate Dispersions (PERMDISP)
list_dist_tests() match_dist_test()
Find and Browse Distance Tests

Interpreting Differences

Which taxa drive the differences between groups.

simper()
Similarity Percentages (SIMPER)

Plotting

plot() methods for ecodive’s results. They draw what a result already holds, with titles, labels and legends taken from its attributes, in base graphics.

plot(<ecodive_ord>)
Plot an ordination
plot(<ecodive_dist>)
Plot a distance matrix
plot(<ecodive_envfit>)
Plot fitted variables
plot(<ecodive_test>) plot(<ecodive_mrpp>) plot(<ecodive_permdisp>) plot(<ecodive_procrustes_test>)
Plot a permutation test
plot(<ecodive_simper>)
Plot a SIMPER result
plot(<ecodive_dirmult_ttest>)
Plot a Dirichlet-multinomial t-test
plot(<ecodive_ancom>)
Plot an ANCOM result
plot(<ecodive_ancombc>) plot(<ecodive_ancombc_pairwise>) plot(<ecodive_ancombc_dunnett>) plot(<ecodive_ancombc_global>) plot(<ecodive_ancombc_trend>)
Plot an ANCOM-BC result
plot(<ecodive_varpart>)
Plot a variation partitioning
plot(<ecodive_forward_select>)
Plot a forward selection
plot(<ecodive_bioenv>)
Plot a BIO-ENV result
ecodive_steps
How a result was made
